'''Kleiv''', also known as '''Kleiv the Wanderer''', was the name of a diseased [[vorantikus]] that lived in the [[Nightmare Lands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], prowling the [[Sha-Thes Meadow]]. It was [[Death/Legends|slain]] around [[3640 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kleiv appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Voss]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by characters of both factions for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
